modules.name: agent-chat
modules.purpose: Chat-panel runtime for autonomous coding agents (ACP local and cloud): session lifecycle, transcript persistence/archival, capability negotiation, git worktree handling, model discovery, and pending file-write approval.

business_rules.description: Terminal state invariant: once completed/failed/cancelled/ended-by-shutdown, no further transitions; new runs create new sessions.
At-most-one-queued follow-up: while a turn is in flight only one follow-up may be queued; a second submission throws.
Transcript archival thresholds: >10,000 messages OR >2 MB approx JSON triggers archiving the oldest 25% to JSONL on disk.
Retention eviction cap: manifest keeps at most 100 sessions; evicted sessions with worktrees migrate to orphaned-worktrees list.
Concurrent ACP session cap: only ACP sessions count; at cap the user is prompted to cancel an idle session (waiting-for-input prioritized).
Shutdown atomicity: on deactivate, all non-terminal ACP sessions are stamped 'ended-by-shutdown' in a single workspaceState update.
Cloud sessions are read-only: no submit()/retry(); follow-up input is rejected.
Capability precedence: agent-reported (ACP initialize) wins over static catalog when it reports modes/models/acceptsFollowUp.
Mode/model change applies to next turn (audited via system message), not the in-flight turn.
Worktree cleanup with uncommitted/unpushed changes throws WorktreeCleanupWarningRequired unless confirmedDestructive=true.
Pending writes block agent execution: writeTextFile RPC awaits user accept/reject.
Model discovery cache TTL: 5 min for resolved models, 1 min for 'none' results.

algorithms: Transcript archival (oldest-25% pivot to JSONL on count/size threshold)
Capacity check + idle-session sorting (waiting-for-input first, then oldest updatedAt)
Diff stats via line-frequency maps (git --shortstat semantics)
Model discovery lookup chain (Copilot cache -> ACP probe -> catalog -> none) with in-flight coalescing
Hybrid capability resolution (agent-wins merge over catalog)
Worktree creation (resolve root -> verify git/HEAD -> git worktree add -> seed .gitignore)

modules.name: agents
modules.purpose: Loads agent-definition markdown files (.agent.md with YAML frontmatter), validates them, registers each as a VS Code chat participant via the Copilot Chat API, and provides a tool registry, resource cache (prompts/skills/instructions), and a debounced file-watcher for hot-reload.

fields.name: (values)
fields.type: VALIDATION | RESOURCE | EXECUTION | CANCELLATION | TIMEOUT | UNKNOWN

business_rules.description: Agent id must match /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ (kebab-case).
name, fullName, description required (non-empty); agent must have >=1 command; each command requires name/description/tool.
Auto-inject /help command (tool 'agent.help') when missing.
Tool name must match /^[a-z0-9.-]+$/ and be unique (duplicate registration throws).
Only .agent.md files are processed; directories scanned recursively; frontmatter required.
Resource paths must be <dir>/<type>/<name> with type in {prompts,skills,instructions}; deleted files evicted from cache on reload.
File watcher debounces changes by 500ms to batch rapid edits (hot-reload).
Errors categorized into 6 categories; user messages sanitized (paths stripped, capped 200 chars); severity mapped by category.

algorithms: Frontmatter parsing + AgentDefinition extraction (gray-matter, auto-/help injection)
Parallel resource cache loading (prompts/skills/instructions, recursive nested)
Incremental cache reload (per-changed-file update/delete, O(1) lookups)
Help content formatting (general list + command-specific extraction from markdown)
Error formatting + categorization + sanitization
Tool execution with timing + error wrapping (ToolExecutionError)

modules.name: cloud-agents
modules.purpose: Provider-agnostic cloud-agent integration layer that abstracts Devin and the GitHub Copilot coding agent behind a common CloudAgentProvider interface, with unified polling (grace periods + backoff), normalized session/task/PR state, credential gating, a provider registry, migration from legacy Devin config, and 7-day session cleanup.

fields.name: (values)
fields.type: PENDING | RUNNING | BLOCKED | COMPLETED | FAILED | CANCELLED

fields.name: (values)
fields.type: CREDENTIALS_MISSING | CREDENTIALS_INVALID | SESSION_NOT_FOUND | API_RATE_LIMITED | NETWORK_ERROR | TIMEOUT | ...

business_rules.description: Polling: active sessions polled continuously; sessions with open PRs polled within grace period (5m known PR state, 1h unknown); terminal PR states excluded.

Terminal-state normalization: on COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED, non-terminal tasks derived to match (COMPLETED->COMPLETED, FAILED->FAILED, else SKIPPED); unknown PR state inferred merged (if COMPLETED) else open.
Credential gating: creation blocked if credentials missing; polling stops after 3 consecutive failures; credential-expiry fires onCredentialExpiry (FR-020).
Provider resolution: active provider from ProviderRegistry.getActive(); no active provider => polling skipped; provider must be registered before activation.
Retention: sessions cleaned up 7 days after completion.
Migration: if no provider configured and legacy Devin sessions/token exist, auto-set Devin active; orphaned active-provider id cleared (FR-021).
Read-only sessions: when a provider becomes inactive its sessions are marked isReadOnly and excluded from polling/active filters.
PR reconciliation: existing PRs matched by URL preserve createdAt; update skipped when no status/PR change (idempotency).

algorithms: Polling loop (active + grace-period filtering, provider.pollSessions, backoff after 3 failures, credential-expiry callback)
Per-provider status mapping (Devin string map; GitHub issue/PR timeline mapping)
Terminal-state normalization of tasks and PR states on load/update
PR reconciliation (extract from provider response, match by URL, idempotent merge)
Migration (detect legacy Devin -> auto-activate; orphaned-config detection)

modules.name: devin
modules.purpose: Original standalone Devin REST integration (spec 001-devin-integration). Dual API versioning (v1/v2 vs v3 by token prefix), SecretStorage credentials, session lifecycle + 7-day retention in workspaceState, polling with grace cycles + PR-state detection, status mapping, prompt building (single task + task group), sequential batch processing, git validation/commit-push, PR review/link handling, tasks.md checkbox sync, and a deep error taxonomy with retry/backoff + client-side rate limiting. Still wired in extension.ts and partially reused by cloud-agents/devin-adapter.

fields.name: (enum)
fields.type: 12 codes: API_ERROR, TIMEOUT, NETWORK_ERROR, AUTH_FAILED, CREDENTIALS_NOT_FOUND, INVALID_TOKEN_FORMAT, ORG_ID_REQUIRED, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED, VALIDATION_ERROR, MAX_RETRIES_EXCEEDED, INVALID_SESSION_STATE

business_rules.description: Token prefix selects API version: cog_ -> v3 (org-scoped, requires orgId), apk_/apk_user_ -> v1/v2; unknown prefix throws DevinInvalidTokenError.
v3 client requires a non-empty orgId or throws DevinOrgIdRequiredError.
status_detail/status_enum overrides the base status field (base can be stale, e.g. suspended while finished).
HTTP error mapping: 401/403 -> auth, 429 -> rate-limited (parse Retry-After), non-ok -> DevinApiError, AbortError -> timeout, fetch throw -> network.
Cancellation is local-only (Devin API has no cancel endpoint); rejects sessions already in a terminal state.
Task-group prompt forces ONE PR / no per-task branches; branch instructions force the PR target to be the base branch.
7-day session retention; cleanup keeps non-terminal sessions and terminal sessions newer than the cutoff.
Polling default 5s (min 3, max 60); GRACE_CYCLES_AFTER_TERMINAL=6; recently-completed = terminal + updated <5min + has PRs. Terminal sessions re-polled update only PR data.
RUNNING -> BLOCKED emits a blocked event (Devin needs user input); PR-state changes emit events that drive tasks.md checkbox updates.
Retry: 3 attempts, exponential backoff base*2^(n-1) (base 1s, cap 30s, +10% jitter), honors Retry-After; retryable = 5xx, network, timeout, rate-limited.
Client-side rate limiter: >=500ms between calls and <=60 requests/minute (sliding window).
Pre-flight git: workspace must be a git repo with a clean working tree before starting; commitAndPush does git add -A -> commit-if-changes -> push origin <branch>.
Credentials: API key and JSON metadata stored under separate SecretStorage keys; metadata never contains the key; legacy in-JSON-key format read for backward compatibility.

algorithms: Token-prefix API version detection (cog_ -> v3, apk_ -> v1)
Dual-layer status resolution (status_detail map wins over base status map, fallback RUNNING)
Exponential backoff with jitter honoring Retry-After (retry-handler)
Sliding-window client-side rate limiting (timestamps within 60s)
Polling grace window (6 extra cycles after terminal to catch late PR merges)
Session->task status sync (SESSION_TO_TASK_STATUS, terminal tasks frozen)
Markdown checkbox mutation via regex ('- [ ] TXXX' -> '- [x]')
Spec task extraction from markdown (task line + following <=10 lines + bullet acceptance criteria)
external_deps: vscode (SecretStorage, Memento, window, workspace.fs, env, Uri, OutputChannel)

modules.name: hooks
modules.purpose: Event-driven automation engine (spec 011-custom-agent-hooks). A Hook binds a trigger (event source) + optional conditions + schedule to one of six action types (agent, git, github via MCP, mcp tool, custom agent, acp subprocess). Provides $variable template substitution, MCP server discovery/execution pooling, a multi-source agent registry, filesystem-watcher-based command-completion detection, chain-depth/circular-dependency guards, and workspaceState persistence. Largest module in the codebase (~11,190 LOC).

business_rules.description: Hooks persisted to workspaceState under 'gatomia.hooks.configurations'; execution logs under 'gatomia.hooks.execution-logs'.
Hook name must be unique and <=100 chars; id must be UUID v4; id/createdAt/executionCount are immutable on update.
On load, hooks are migrated in place: default timing 'after'; legacy trigger -> normalized events[] + schedule {immediate}; MCP agentId -> modelId.
Trigger matching requires agent + operation + same timing (legacy trigger or normalized events); matches sorted by createdAt for deterministic order.
Blocking execution only when timing='before' AND waitForCompletion is set.
Async validation: MCP action validates server/tool reference; custom action validates agent exists (availability is warn-only, non-blocking).
Circular-dependency block (executedHooks set) and max chain depth = 10 (MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH).
Action timeout default 30s (ACTION_TIMEOUT_MS); execution logs capped at 100 (FIFO).
Template $variableName: missing/undefined substitutes empty string (graceful); invalid name or $-then-space is a syntax error.
MCP discovery cache TTL 5min; execution concurrency capped at 5; per-call timeout clamped 1s-5min.
Command completion detected via filesystem watchers per operation pattern (e.g. specs/*/spec.md), parse-validate, 2s debounce.
TemplateVariableParser.validateVariables is a stub that always returns valid (TODO Phase 4 not implemented) - availability warnings are not enforced at parse time.

algorithms: Trigger matching (filter enabled hooks by agent/operation/timing, sort by createdAt)
In-place schema migration of stored hooks on load (timing default, legacy->normalized, field rename)
Template substitution via regex /\$([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\b/g with graceful empty for missing vars
Execution-chain cycle protection (per-execution Set<hookId> + depth counter capped at 10)
Hybrid command-completion detection (FileSystemWatcher + parseability check + 2s debounce)
MCP execution pooling (bounded concurrency 5 with per-call timeout clamping)
ACP subprocess session (spawn -> JSON-RPC handshake -> session -> prompt -> collect, with timeout/error states)
external_deps: vscode (workspaceState, EventEmitter, FileSystemWatcher, window, Git extension API, LanguageModel API)

modules.name: orchestration
modules.purpose: Thin backend behind the orchestration dashboard / Kanban board. A read-model aggregates agent-chat + cloud-agent sessions into a unified bucketed snapshot; an autonomous agent loop bridges the Kanban task model (tasks/NormalizedTask) to spawned agent-chat sessions and fires hooks triggers on task completion/failure. The React Flow composer and Kanban UI live in the webview (webview-orchestration).

business_rules.description: Snapshot merges agent-chat (active+recent, registry overrides store by id) and cloud sessions, sorted by bucket rank then lastVisibleActivityAt descending.
Bucket rank order: active(0) -> waiting(1) -> completed(2) -> failed(3).
Graceful degradation: missing cloud session storage or provider wiring pushes human-readable degradedReasons instead of throwing.
claimTask rejects tasks already running/completed; rejects a new task while another is running unless execution.parallelizable.
startTask only proceeds from 'queued'; generates a UUID sessionId, registers an agent-chat session, maps session<->task, sets running.
On task terminal state, fires orchestration.task-completed / task-failed hook trigger with the task JSON as outputContent.

AutonomousAgentLoopService builds an AgentChatSession with a simplified shape that does not match the canonical agent-chat AgentChatSession; handleRegistryChange checks lifecycleState !== 'error' (not a canonical lifecycle state) - completion detection is heuristic/provisional.

algorithms: Two-source session merge (de-dup by id, registry wins over store, unified projection)
Stable bucket+recency sort (bucket rank then lastVisibleActivityAt desc)
Bucket derivation (separate lifecycle->bucket maps for agent-chat vs cloud)
Title derivation (first non-empty user message, fallback to agent/mode label)
Completion sync (registry change -> mark mapped running tasks completed/failed)

modules.name: spec
modules.purpose: Spec lifecycle management for two SDD systems (SpecKit .specify/ and OpenSpec openspec/, via adapter/strategy) plus the review-flow state machine (spec 001-auto-review-transition). Owns spec creation (webview input -> Copilot Chat prompt), document CRUD/navigation, unified cross-system listing, the spec status FSM (current -> review -> reopened -> archived), change-request lifecycle with archival blockers, task dispatch from change requests, auto-review transitions, and telemetry. Review-flow state persists to .vscode/gatomia/spec-review-state.json.

business_rules.description: FSM valid transitions: current->review; review->{reopened,archived,current}; reopened->review; archived->reopened. Invalid transitions rejected. readyToReview normalized to review.
Send-to-review gated: must be current/reopened with zero pending tasks and zero pending checklist items.
First entry to review stamps completedAt + reviewEnteredAt; entry to archived stamps archivedAt.
Adding a change request while in review transitions the spec to reopened.
New CR is open + archivalBlocker=true; attaching tasks sets inProgress; all tasks done -> addressed (blocker cleared); reverting a done task re-opens to inProgress.
Archive gated on review status + zero pending + no blocking change requests; unarchive moves archived->reopened and clears archivedAt.
Pending tasks/checklist appearing during review force exit (reopened if blockers else current) with a warning notification.
Auto-review: on every state change, eligible specs are auto-sent to review; failures go to a retry queue.
Duplicate change requests rejected by normalized (lowercase/trim/collapse-space) title, excluding addressed CRs.
Review-flow state persisted to .vscode/gatomia/spec-review-state.json (load-on-first-access, write-after-mutation); module-level singleton cache.
OpenSpec submission requires .github/prompts/openspec-proposal.prompt.md and instructs the agent to STOP for user approval before implementing.
dispatchToTasksPrompt is a MOCK: simulates 500-1500ms latency, fails 10% randomly, returns two hard-coded tasks. Not wired to a real task generator.

algorithms: FSM transition validation via allowed-transitions table + status normalization (legacy alias)
Review gating (accumulate blocker strings: status, pending tasks, pending checklist)
Auto-return to review (all CRs addressed AND all tasks done AND zero pending)
Auto-review evaluation (iterate cache + retry queue on each change event)
Duplicate detection (normalized title comparison among non-addressed CRs)
Date (de)serialization (ISO strings <-> Date) + optional-count coercion

modules.name: steering
modules.purpose: Manages AI steering documents (project constitution / OpenSpec AGENTS.md, global ~/.github/copilot-instructions.md, project/user *.instructions.md rules) and a 3-state (ask/allow/deny) consent gate controlling whether the extension may read global home-directory Copilot resources for a workspace. Document creation typically delegates to Copilot Chat (e.g. /speckit.constitution).

business_rules.description: Global config written to ~/.github/copilot-instructions.md (overwrite-confirmed).
Project docs: SpecKit -> /speckit.constitution <directives> chat prompt; OpenSpec -> write openspec/AGENTS.md. No SDD system -> user must pick (persisted to settings + adapter re-init).

Instruction-rule name must normalize to lowercase kebab-case; file is <name>.instructions.md with applyTo '**' frontmatter; project -> .github/instructions/, user -> ~/.github/instructions/; refuses to overwrite existing files.
Effective global-resource access: workspace override (allow/deny) wins over global default (ask/allow/deny, default ask).
Consent persistence fallback chain: workspace config -> global config -> .vscode/settings.json -> workspaceState. Dismissing the prompt suppresses re-prompts for the session.
ConstitutionManager.validateConstitution is a placeholder stub that always returns true (no validation performed).

algorithms: Kebab-case normalization (trim/lowercase, collapse non-alphanumerics to dash, trim dashes, validate pattern)
Effective-access resolution (workspace override precedence over global default)
Multi-tier consent persistence fallback (workspace config -> global config -> settings.json file -> workspaceState)

modules.name: tasks
modules.purpose: Pluggable task-source layer. Reads tasks.md from either SDD system (SpecKit/OpenSpec) via path-matched providers and normalizes entries into a common NormalizedTask shape consumed by the Kanban board (webview) and the orchestration autonomous loop. Markdown parsing is delegated to utils/task-parser.

business_rules.description: Provider selection by canHandle path test: openspec/ -> OpenSpec; .specify or specs/ (not openspec) -> SpecKit.
Task IDs scoped to spec for uniqueness: ${specId}-${task.id}.
Status mapping: completed->completed, in-progress->in-progress, else->not-started; execution state: completed->completed, in-progress->running, else->ready.
No matching provider or parse failure -> a single isUnsupported placeholder task (graceful degradation); getTasksForSpec returns empty when tasks file is missing.
SpecKitTaskProvider and OpenSpecTaskProvider are near-duplicates (identical normalize/map logic, differing only in name and canHandle).

algorithms: Provider dispatch (first provider whose canHandle matches)
Group normalization (flatten TaskGroup[] -> NormalizedTask[], scope ids, map status/execution state)
Graceful degradation (unsupported/unparseable -> single placeholder task)

modules.name: providers
modules.purpose: VS Code UI registration layer: TreeDataProviders, WebviewViewProviders, two webview panels (welcome, hooks), a CodeLens provider and a Copilot wrapper. Projects feature-layer state into tree items / postMessage payloads and translates user actions into commands; holds little domain logic itself.

functions.name: SidebarSessionBinding.handleInputSubmit
params: payload: { sessionId: string; content: string; clientMessageId?: string }

business_rules.description: Agent Chat view declared twice (auxiliary + primary containers), gated by gatomia.host.chatInPrimary; reveal() fires both .focus commands and the inactive one no-ops.
Exactly one session bound at a time; rebinding disposes the prior SidebarSessionBinding.
Cloud sessions are read-only and terminal sessions reject follow-up input.
Transcript forwarded as append-only deltas diffed by message id, not full re-renders.
permissionDefault writes to Global config; the config-change listener rebroadcasts to the webview (single source of truth).
Spec tree refresh debounced 2s on **/specs/**/*.md changes and on review-flow state changes; grouping derived from review-flow status (no status => Current).
GatomIA-CLI install gated on host prerequisites (windsurf=>Devin CLI; antigravity=>Gemini CLI; else Copilot Chat+CLI) plus at least one spec system.
Hooks-panel outbound messages buffered until hooks.ready, then flushed; HookExecutor events mirrored into a per-hook status cache.

algorithms: Append-only transcript delta (diff persisted transcript against knownMessageIds, post only fresh messages)
Session-title derivation (first non-empty user message, whitespace-collapsed, truncated to 60 chars)
Dual-view focus (issue both <viewId>.focus commands in parallel; host-gated one no-ops)
Probe coalescing (single in-flight refreshProbes promise; Promise.allSettled over ACP descriptor probes; rebroadcast only when an installed flag flips)
Discovered-model overlay (vscode-lm/agent replace static models; none empties picker; catalog keeps static list)
Tree projection (feature state -> TreeItem with theme icons/colors and contextValue-driven menus)

modules.name: services
modules.purpose: Core business-logic layer beneath providers/panels/commands. Three subsystems: the ACP runtime (acp/) that spawns local agent CLIs over stdio JSON-RPC and powers agent-chat; the chat-dispatch pipeline (chat-router -> chat-dispatcher -> ACP or Copilot Chat fallback) plus agent-service; and the document preview/refinement + welcome-screen support services. prompt-loader and configuration-service are cross-cutting.

business_rules.description: One AcpClient subprocess per (providerId, cwd) for worktree isolation; session keys derived by mode: workspace=_ws_, per-spec=spec:<id>, per-prompt=once:<uuid>.
Per-prompt (once:) sessions are deleted after the turn completes or on cancel.
writeTextFile is buffered for user approval when bufferFileWrites is set (else direct write); rejection is surfaced to the agent RPC.
requestPermission honors permission mode and remembers allow_always/reject_always per ToolKind for the client lifetime.
setSessionModel uses the experimental unstable_setSessionModel; when missing it throws ACP_NOT_SUPPORTED so callers downgrade to a legacy record-model flow.
npx spawns are gated behind a one-time consent hook per (providerId, cwd).
Chat routing: gatomia.chat.provider override; ACP disabled in remote workspaces; auto mode picks provider by host then probe (installed -> acpSupported -> authenticated); 60s decision cache.
ACP dispatch rewrites a leading /command prompt into natural language so ACP agents do not treat it as their own slash command; Copilot Chat files param only sent on VS Code >= 1.95.0.
Remote ACP registry cached 24h with a 3s fetch timeout; remote entries are metadata-only until a spawn command is provided.
Refinement maps doc type to a SpecKit command (spec->/speckit.specify, plan->/speckit.plan, task->/speckit.tasks, checklist->/speckit.checklist; default /speckit.clarify).

algorithms: stdio JSON-RPC bridge (spawn CLI -> Writable/Readable.toWeb -> ndJsonStream -> ClientSideConnection; PATH extended via getExtendedPath)
Session-update dispatch by sessionUpdate kind (chunks, plan, commands, mode/session_info/usage, tool_call/tool_call_update with diff-stat extraction)
Remembered-permission memo keyed by ToolKind (re-resolve live optionId from incoming options array)
Startup-timeout race (withStartupTimeout registers reject-waiter so a stuck initialize or process exit fails fast)
Slash-command rewrite (first-line regex -> 'Run the <cmd> workflow ...' preserving following lines)
Markdown sectioning (split by ## headings -> PreviewSection[]; non-md mapped to a syntax language by extension)

modules.name: panels
modules.purpose: Standalone vscode.WebviewPanel wrappers (editor-area panels) — counterpart to the sidebar WebviewViewProviders in `providers`. Each class owns one panel lifecycle: create/reveal, load the shared React bundle by page id via getWebviewContent, broker that surface's postMessage protocol, and dispose idempotently. Members: full per-session Agent Chat panel, singleton Welcome screen, read-only Document Preview, lightweight New Session picker (stub HTML), and provider-agnostic Cloud Agent + legacy Devin progress panels with their message handlers.

functions.name: AgentChatPanel.handleInputSubmit
params: payload: { sessionId: string; content: string; clientMessageId?: string }

business_rules.description: AgentChatPanel intentionally does NOT call registry.attachPanel — the command handler is the single source of truth for panel registration (one-panel-per-session invariant; regression seen in spec 018).
Cloud (read-only) sessions reject input/submit immediately; terminal-state sessions also reject follow-up input; missing runner or runner without submit() => message marked rejected.
Transcript pushed to webview as append-only deltas diffed by message id (knownMessageIds), never full re-render; transcript read via a tightly-scoped cast into the store's memento (transcriptKeyFor).
WelcomeScreenPanel is a process-wide singleton (static currentPanel); show() reveals the existing instance (FR-017).
NewSessionPanel self-disposes after every start attempt (success or failure) to hand off to the real Agent Chat panel; open() throws if the panel was already disposed.
Welcome and Document Preview panels buffer outbound messages in pendingMessages until the webview posts '*/ready', then flush FIFO.
Cloud progress displayStatus comes from the active provider's getStatusDisplay(session), falling back to the raw status.

algorithms: Optimistic user-message render (append pending -> runner.submit -> patch delivered/rejected)
Append-only transcript delta (knownMessageIds diff)
Ready-gated message buffer + FIFO flush
AgentSession -> progress view DTO projection (tasks/PRs/display-status)
Self-disposal handoff (try onStart finally dispose) for the new-session picker

modules.name: commands
modules.purpose: VS Code command-handler layer. Declares gatomia.* command-id maps and exports register*Commands(deps): Disposable[] (called from extension.ts), with handler logic as pure, dependency-injected functions for unit testing. Three families: Agent Chat panel (spec 018), Cloud Agent multi-provider (spec 016), legacy Devin (spec 001). Handlers own orchestration logic (concurrent-cap enforcement, two-step destructive confirmation, bounded retry, duplicate-dispatch guards); registration normalizes arg shapes (raw string vs tree-item from view/item/context).

business_rules.description: handleStartNew is the single source of truth for panel registration (registerSession + attachRunner + attachPanel); the panel never self-registers.
Concurrent-ACP-cap enforcement runs only when both concurrentCap and registry.checkCapacity are wired; without a promptForCap helper it fails closed (abort).
openForSession lazily hydrates the registry from the store after reload (T047), then honors one-panel-per-session via focusPanel (emits PANEL_REOPENED).

changeModel prefers experimental session/set_model; only ACP_NOT_SUPPORTED triggers fallback to recordModelChange + store update, other errors re-thrown. Mode change recorded in transcript before persist (effective next turn). Execution-target change rejected when lifecycleState==='running'.
Worktree cleanup is two-step destructive: WorktreeCleanupWarningRequired -> warning{inspection}; caller re-invokes with confirmedDestructive=true.

Cloud dispatch retries at most twice and only when ProviderError.recoverable (linear backoff 1000*(attempt+1) ms); blocks duplicate dispatch for the same spec-task id; cancel refuses read-only sessions; polling auto-starts at 30s on first dispatch.
New-session QuickPick groups providers by availability tier; install-required opens the install URL instead of starting (npx confirmation modal removed).
Devin cog_-prefixed API keys additionally require an Organization ID (v3 API); task start gated by validateGitState + confirmation dialog.

algorithms: Concurrent-cap enforcement decision (checkCapacity -> prompt -> abort/cancel-and-start/cancel-only)
Tier-grouped QuickPick build (3 buckets + separators, re-resolve pick against original list)
Bounded recoverable retry (<=2, ProviderError.recoverable only, linear backoff)
Two-step destructive confirm (warning{inspection} then confirmedDestructive)
Arg coercion (string | tree-item -> id) and lazy vscode resolution (separatorKind / parseUriSafe)

modules.name: utils
modules.purpose: Cross-cutting shared-utilities layer consumed by every other module. Five clusters: (1) spec-system abstraction (unified facade over SpecKit numbered specs/NNN-slug + .specify and OpenSpec openspec/specs); (2) markdown parsing (tasks.md, checklists, YAML frontmatter, friendly titles); (3) Copilot/MCP integration via VS Code Language Model API (vscode.lm); (4) platform & IDE-host detection (multi-fork data-dir/MCP-config resolution, CLI probing with extended PATH); (5) webview/chat/state/telemetry helpers (shared webview HTML builder, chat-prompt decorator+dispatcher, welcome workspace-state, preview telemetry).

fields.name: speckit.paths
fields.type: { specs; memory; templates; scripts; agents; skills }

business_rules.description: Active spec system: explicit gatomia.specSystem wins; else auto-detect; if both SpecKit and OpenSpec present and no pref, prompt + persist (cancel -> default SpecKit, not persisted).
SpecKit feature dir must match ^\d{3,}-(.+)$; next number = max existing + 1; features sorted by number. Files not in KNOWN_SPEC_FILES/KNOWN_SPEC_FOLDERS surfaced as extra:/extra-folder: entries.
Task status: explicit **STATUS** marker overrides acceptance-criteria ratio; phase headers excluded via a denylist of summary/meta headings.

MCP discovery degrades gracefully (missing vscode.lm/lm.tools -> empty, never throws on availability check); tools without a matched server fall to other-tools; invokeTool uses toolInvocationToken: undefined (outside chat request).
mcp.json resolution is profile-aware (newest-modified profile wins, else User/mcp.json); WSL resolves Windows %APPDATA% via cmd.exe + wslpath; multi-fork IDE dir mapping by appName.
checkCLI runs with an extended PATH (UV/cargo/bun/deno/homebrew) and falls back to which/where; ACP routing eligible only on Windsurf/Antigravity and non-remote workspaces.
Webview HTML uses a per-render 32-char nonce + strict CSP (script-src 'nonce-...'); data-attrs HTML-escaped. chat.open passes the files arg only on VS Code >= 1.95.0.

Migration always creates a timestamped backup .openspec-backup-<iso> before writing; maps OpenSpec design.md -> plan.md, keeps requirements.md as extra. Preview telemetry capped at 1000 entries/type; targets SC-001 (95% <3s) and SC-002 (90% diagram success).

algorithms: Dual-format tasks.md parse (inline + header + acceptance-criteria ratio status)
MCP tool->server correlation heuristics (built-in -> substring/path/hyphen -> mcp_ prefix -> fallback)
Multi-fork data-dir + profile-aware mcp.json resolution (incl. WSL cmd.exe+wslpath)
CLI version extraction (JSON-first then ordered semver regex) with extended PATH + which/where fallback
Lightweight YAML frontmatter parse + title fallback chain (frontmatter -> H1 -> filename)
p95/summary telemetry rollups; recursive markdown discovery for unknown spec subfolders

modules.name: prompts
modules.purpose: Built-in prompt-template library: markdown sources with YAML frontmatter + Handlebars placeholders, compiled by `npm run build-prompts` into target/*.ts data modules (frontmatter + content + default). target/index.ts barrels them. Consumed by services/prompt-loader.ts which compiles Handlebars, validates required variables, and renders. The four prompts implement the SpecKit workflow chain (specify -> plan -> tasks) plus a demo example.

business_rules.description: target/*.ts are generated (DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY banner) from *.prompt.md/*.md via build-prompts; target/index.ts re-exports example, specKitPlan, specKitSpecify, specKitTasks.
SpecKit prompt chain: specify(context) -> spec; plan(spec) -> plan; tasks(plan) -> Markdown checklist. Each prompt declares exactly one required variable.

algorithms: Frontmatter+body compile to TS data module (gray-matter parse -> escaped content literal + barrel index)

modules.name: webview-agent-chat
modules.purpose: React webview for the Agent Chat Panel (client half of the extension-side agent-chat module). Renders sidebar + legacy panel surfaces from one tree, holds all chat state in a single useReducer store, and drives the host only via the postMessage bridge. Owns transcript rendering, follow-up InputBar, empty-state NewSessionComposer, session switching, pending file-write Accept/Reject, and model/mode/thinking/agent-role/permission chips.

fields.name: (union)
fields.type: session/loaded | messages/appended | messages/updated | session/lifecycle-changed | session/cleared | catalog/loaded | session/models-changed | sessions/list-changed | pending-writes/changed | permission-default/changed

business_rules.description: Webview must not import from src/; types.ts is a hand-maintained mirror of the extension contract, updated in the same commit.
Appended messages are deduped against a Set of seen ids (idempotent re-delivery); no-op when all ids already present.
Panel surface drops session/loaded whose session.id != initialSessionId; sidebar drops messages/lifecycle/models/pending-writes whose payload.sessionId != activeSessionId.
permission-default/changed ignores any value other than ask|allow|deny.
InputBar is disabled by precedence readOnly -> !acceptsFollowUp -> terminal, each with a distinct reason string; Enter submits, Shift+Enter newlines; submit requires non-empty trimmed value.
ModelChip render contract: dynamic <select> when availableModels non-empty, else 'Loading models...' label while probing, else static modelLabel, else hidden.

NewSessionComposer default provider = first enabled; canSubmit = providerId set AND non-empty prompt; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter submits; switching provider resets model/thinking/role (keeps workspace-scoped agent file) and re-probes models.

algorithms: Reducer-based bridge state machine with Set-dedup append and per-variant discriminated-union patching
postMessage translation layer (type -> handler map -> typed BridgeAction) with session-id scoping
Surface inference from data-surface / data-session-id DOM attributes
Provider-id derivation (cloud.providerId ?? agentId) for probe-models dispatch

modules.name: webview-spec-explorer
modules.purpose: Spec authoring + review-flow webview surfaces: simple (static), interactive (message playground), create-spec and create-steering (autosaving forms), plus the Spec Explorer review-flow components (ready-to-review/changes/archived lists, change-request form/actions) backed by an observable store and a request/response messaging service.

functions.name: SpecExplorerService.submitChangeRequest
params: options: { specId; title; description; severity; submitter }

fields.name: (union)
fields.type: ready-to-review:fetch | ready-to-review:specs-updated | changes:fetch | changes:updated | change-request:file | change-request:submit | change-request:submitted | spec:navigate

fields.name: (union)
fields.type: create-spec/init | submit:success | submit:error | confirm-close | focus | import-markdown:result | attach-images:result

business_rules.description: Spec/ChangeRequest types are imported directly from src/features/spec/review-flow/types by the store and review components (compile-time coupling), deviating from the no-src-import rule that webview-agent-chat follows. The service keeps a parallel local copy.
SpecExplorerService acquires its own acquireVsCodeApi() stored on window.specExplorerVscode, separate from the shared @/bridge/vscode singleton.
fetchReadyToReviewSpecs / fetchChangeRequests resolve to an empty array after a 5s timeout if the host does not respond.
ChangeRequestForm requires title + description + severity; duplicate detection normalizes titles (lowercase/trim/collapse-whitespace) and matches against non-addressed change requests.

create-spec requires a non-empty trimmed description; 600ms debounced autosave writes vscode.setState + create-spec/autosave; markdown import asks for confirmation when text is present; a beforeunload guard fires when dirty.
create-steering requires summary (other 3 fields optional); dirty check via areFormsEqual; 600ms autosave; beforeunload guard.
interactive-view sends on Cmd/Ctrl+Enter using command-keyed messages (interactive-view.sendMessage / showMessage), distinct from the type-keyed conventions elsewhere.

algorithms: useSyncExternalStore observable store with Set<Listener> and immutable state replacement
Promise-with-timeout request/response over postMessage (one-shot subscription + 5s fallback to [])
Duplicate change-request detection via title normalization and active-CR scan
Debounced autosave (600ms) to vscode.setState + host message, gated by lastPersisted equality

modules.name: webview-hooks-view
modules.purpose: Webview for the automation hooks UI (client of the extension-side hooks module). Create/edit/toggle/delete hooks that fire before/after agent operations and run one of six action types (agent, git, github, custom, mcp, acp). Hosts the hook list, multi-step hook form with per-action-type sub-forms, MCP server/tool discovery + selection, GitHub Copilot CLI option panels, ACP local-agent config, and the execution-logs panel. Largest webview module.

fields.name: (flags)
fields.type: directory/path, tool perms, URL perms, GitHub MCP, MCP config, execution, output/logging, session, allowAll

business_rules.description: Dual-keyed protocol: webview sends command = type with / replaced by .; reads type ?? command and payload ?? data so both spellings work.
The hook form is NOT reset on hooks/sync (avoids a race); it closes only on explicit cancel or successful save/delete.
Create payload omits id/createdAt/modifiedAt/executionCount (assigned by the host).
TriggerCondition.waitForCompletion is only meaningful for 'before' timing; ACP execution mode is 'local' only in v1.
MCP server-id extraction assumes server ids never contain underscores; domain (.) and path (/) notation handled by finding the first underscore after the last / or .
groupToolsByProvider sorts groups alphabetically by server name and tools by displayName; selected tools whose server is unknown are collected into a synthetic 'Other' group appended last.

algorithms: MCP tool-name parsing (server-id boundary detection across simple/path/domain ids)
Server/tool display formatting (known-server map + acronym normalization + title-casing)
Tool grouping with two-level alpha sort + orphaned-selection 'Other' group
Discovery hooks: request/response over postMessage with loading/error state and dual-keyed type matching
external_deps: postMessage bridge -> extension hooks module (+ MCP discovery, model cache, ACP catalog)

modules.name: webview-orchestration
modules.purpose: Agent-orchestration / monitoring webview surfaces. Two mounted pages: orchestration (Running Agents Prototype: buckets active/recent local + cloud sessions into lanes) and workflow-composer (React Flow editor mapping automation hooks into an event->condition->schedule->action graph). Also a prototype graveyard: the Kanban board and the legacy Devin/Cloud-Agent progress views are built but NOT reachable through page-registry.tsx.

business_rules.description: Orchestration sessions arrive pre-bucketed (active/waiting/completed/failed) from the host snapshot
Empty-state copy is a first-match decision tree over degradedReasons + provider availability
Composer dual-key protocol: command = type with / -> .; reads type ?? command, payload ?? data
mapHooksToGraph layout: hook lane y = hookIndex*150*3; columns step x += 300; schedule node skipped when immediate
GAP: KanbanBoard has no importer in ui/src or src (built but unmounted)
GAP: panels request pages devin-progress / cloud-agent-progress that are absent from page-registry.tsx (renders 'Unknown page')

algorithms: Bucket grouping of sessions into 4 lanes
Degraded-mode empty-state predicate cascade
Hook -> React Flow node/edge mapping with deterministic lane layout
Kanban grouping of NormalizedTask by execution.state into 6 columns

modules.name: webview-preview
modules.purpose: Document-preview surface (page 'document-preview'). Renders SpecKit/markdown documents into sectioned HTML, mounts interactive Mermaid diagrams into static markup, and hosts three host round-trips: manual refinement (issue reporting), dependency-triggered document update, and embedded interactive forms with client-side validation. Supports a raw 'code' render mode and a TOC outline.

functions.name: taskGroupPlugin
functions.returns: void (injects Execute-Group button on Phase N: h2)

business_rules.description: Mermaid mounts as React components into .mermaid:not([data-processed]) after 100ms; id = mermaid-<djb2hash>-<i>
Refine + form bridges correlate by requestId (crypto.randomUUID fallback) with 10s timeout
submitForm rejects immediately when no fields changed
Field validation: required, dropdown/multiselect option membership, custom minLength/maxLength/pattern
prepareSubmission requires documentId+sessionId, non-read-only, validateAll pass, >=1 dirty field
RefineDialog requires issueType + description >= 20 chars
Internal .md links intercepted -> preview/open-file; Phase N: task-group buttons -> preview/execute-task-group

algorithms: Mermaid diagram mount with djb2 hash ids + per-diagram createRoot
Per-field validation engine aggregated into validationErrors; validateAll before submit
Request/response correlation via pending Map + lazy listener + timeout
Cached markdown-it pipeline with core-ruler Phase-N button injection + mermaid/plantuml fence override

modules.name: webview-welcome
modules.purpose: Onboarding Welcome Screen (page 'welcome-screen'). Five tabbed sections: Setup (dependency detection + install actions), Features (quick-action command cards), Configuration (editable settings), Status (versions/diagnostics), Learn (resource links + search). Detects the IDE host and computes a host-specific dependency requirement profile. The only webview module that uses Zustand.

business_rules.description: Single-init guarded by initializedRef (StrictMode-safe); welcome/ready sent once
Diagnostics list keeps newest 5 ([new, ...old].slice(0,5))
dontShowOnStartup is inverted for the UI ('show on startup')
Host-specific required deps: windsurf->devin-cli, antigravity->gemini-cli, else->copilot-chat+copilot-cli (all + speckit/openspec/gatomia-cli)
ACP hosts (windsurf/antigravity) hide copilot-chat; copilot hosts hide devin-cli+gemini-cli
specSystemReady = speckit.installed OR openspec.installed; if not ready speckit added to missing; missing sorted by INSTALL_ORDER

algorithms: Host-aware requirement profile (required/optional/hidden + missing with install-order sort)
Config update by key linear scan + immutable replace
welcome/* message routing switch with store + local-state effects

modules.name: webview-shared

functions.name: formatRelativeTime
functions.returns: string (just now / Nm / Nh / Nd / N wk ago)

business_rules.description: Single Vite bundle; active page chosen at runtime from #root[data-page] (default 'simple')
Unknown data-page renders a visible 'Unknown page' message (no throw)
Bridge resolves once at import; outside VS Code falls back to a dev echo (getState->{}, setState->no-op)
formatRelativeTime thresholds: <60s just now; <60m Nm; <24h Nh; <7d Nd; else N wk

algorithms: Runtime page routing with code-split lazy imports
Bridge resolution via window.acquireVsCodeApi feature-detect + dev echo stub
Auto-grow textarea via useLayoutEffect scrollHeight
Relative-time bucketing
